key_insight: HVAF-sprayed WC-10Co-4Cr combined the lowest measured wear rate with the best corrosion resistance, while HVOF achieved the highest hardness.
engineering_relevance: HVAF is a promising coating route for 304 stainless steel components requiring both wear and corrosion protection.
method: Deposit WC-10Co-4Cr on 304 stainless steel using APS, detonation spraying, HVOF, and HVAF.
Compare microstructure, Vickers hardness, friction, and volumetric wear rates.
Evaluate corrosion performance and identify wear mechanisms.
evidence_signal: HVAF reduced volumetric wear rate from (36.82±0.80)×10⁻⁵ for bare steel to (1.10±0.01)×10⁻⁵ mm³/(N·m) and showed the lowest coating corrosion current density, 1.75±0.02 µA/cm².
watch_item: The abstract does not specify wear-test or corrosion-exposure conditions, limiting direct extrapolation to service environments.
paper_title: Microstructure, Wear and Corrosion Resistances of Atmospheric Plasma, Detonation, High Velocity Oxy-fuel and High Velocity Air-fuel Sprayed WC-10Co-4Cr Cemented Carbide Coatings
